senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; preced., tender, young; lad. Tanḥ. Ḥayé 1 שיתכבד הזקן בַּנַּ׳ that the old may be honored by the young.
units: <cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 1:19">Ex. R. s. 1</cite> <he>ילד היה ומנהגו כנ׳</he> he was a child, but his behavior was like that of a lad; a. fr.—Pl. <he>נְעָרִים</he>.

<cite ref="Yoma 75b:12">Yoma 75ᵇ</cite> <he>לנ׳ לחם וכ׳</he> the manna was bread to the young, oil to the old &c. Tanḥ. Sh’mini 11 <he>אם נ׳ הם וכ׳</he> if they (the elders) are young &c., v. <cite ref="S01764"><he>קָפַץ</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Yoma 75b:12">Ib.</cite> <he>הבחורים והנ׳</he> the young men and the lads.

Sot. 46ᵇ נ׳ היו ובזבזו וכ׳ they were young men, but behaved contemptibly like children; a. fr.—Fem. נַעֲרָה lass, maid, esp. (law) a girl between twelve and twelve and a half years of age, v. בַּגְרוּת.
<cite ref="Esther Rabbah 9:1">Esth. R. to V, 1</cite>; a. fr.—
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:8">Keth. III, 8</cite>, contrad. to <he>בוגרת</he> a. <cite ref="S00797"><he>קטנה</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 4:1">Ib. IV, 1</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="N01010"><he>נְעָרוֹת</he></cite>, constr. <cite ref="N01010"><he>נַעֲרוֹת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Ketubot 3:1">Ib. III, 1</cite> (<cite ref="Ketubot 29a:3">29ᵃ</cite>). Esth. R. l. c. <he>שתי נַעֲרוֹתֶיהָ</he> her two maids; a. fr.
